why: owner 26 Nov: the 1.1.6-beta DRAFT again, now with the game's own windows in Persian (not published)

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.1.6-beta for WoW Forever 1.60.1

New: the game's own windows in Persian
- The game menu, character (stats, reputation, skills, honour), bags and bank, the spellbook tabs, friends / who / guild / raid, mail, trade, merchant, auction house, trainers, loot and the group finder: about 430 texts.
- Switch: General > the game's windows (on by default). Off puts every English text back at once.
- Safe for the action bars: the game's own texts are never overwritten, only what a window shows; secure buttons are never touched and nothing changes during combat (it is applied when the fight ends).

Settings
- The panel is ordered by topic: General, Quests (with the quest tracker and Questie), Map and zones, NPCs and talk, Chat and messages, Spells and talents, Font sizes, Colours, Profiles, Status, About.
- The NPC talk switch left the Quests page. Quest titles in the gossip window now follow the quest-title switch.
- Every page starts with one line that says what it covers.

New Persian
- 73 NPC talk lines that many NPCs share (trainers, flight masters, vendors, festivals).
